summary: Forty more shared vehicle parts: track guards, suspension, exhausts, searchlights, benches, tanker fittings, cranes, gun mounts, muzzle brakes, helicopter gear, bombs and markings.
rationale: Static construction change: one matched close-up sheet of eight representative vehicles. Per-part review captures stay outside Git; much of the added hardware is small at gameplay distance.
